name: SU543
source:
In the age when human beings protected themselves 
against environmental pollution by staying in a domed city, 
I had met her who appeared in front of me as a teacher.

Her name's called Aina.
Today, after school, I was attacked by her again...

[From [url=https://hoi-hoi-hoi.itch.io/su543]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在人类靠居住于穹顶城市来保护自己、抵御环境污染的时代，我遇见了她。她以教师的身份出现在我面前。

她的名字叫Aina。
今天放学后，我又遭到了她的袭击……

（来源：[url=https://hoi-hoi-hoi.itch.io/su543]itch.io[/url]）
